name: KURA den on the left wall, TROFAST and play table along the top wall with BESTÅ storage above, toy bench along the bed
notes:
Alternative, re-designed 2026-10-23: the KURA den, now with real storage: the SMÅSTAD toy bench, and the BESTÅ unit on the wall above the play table (F-63). Re-planned the same day for F-31's 36" landings: the bench moves from the closet doors' arc to the KURA's open side, and the book display, 1.5" past the door's arc, comes off the plan because no wall is left for it. 12 placed, 9 extras.
bed-1 KURA in its LOW position only (F-21: no loft bed before 6; IKEA recommends the loft for 6 and older), head on the top wall, long side on the left wall, flush: the frame above the mattress makes the den. Its rails top out at 45 5/8" and invite climbing; the canopy and the BESTÅ unit hang well above and to the side of them. F-34 open side clear for 25.6" between the TROFAST and the toy bench; F-33 bedding 70.6" from the heater face.
toys-1 TROFAST on the top wall beside the KURA's head, the bedside surface (20.5"): F-32 25.6" clear in front of the boxes to the toy bench; no anchoring line on IKEA's page.
table-1 LÄTT on the top wall in the window corner: F-33 right end 7.25" from the heater face; its two chairs sit side by side at its front (y 19 to 30) at x 78-89 and 89-100, so the right one keeps 12" from the heater's face (F-35, the chair side of a child's desk; until the final audit 2026-10-26 they sat at x 82.5-104.5, the right one 7.5" from it); not under the window (13" in from the right wall). lamp-2 RÖDFLIK desk lamp (top) at its left end is her task light, the window on her right (none before the final audit 2026-10-26); its cord fastened along the top wall to an outlet.
cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 47 1/4x16 1/2x15" (top, new): top wall above the TROFAST's end and the play table, x 58.75-106, its right end 6" short of the heater face (F-33), 17" to the side of the KURA's frame, though the TROFAST under it is a 20 1/2" step: closed storage for markers, paint, glue and rotation toys a parent hands down (F-63): solid LAPPVIKEN doors (no glass, F-21), hung on 2 BESTÅ suspension rails screwed into studs (extras), underside about 54" up, 33.5" above the TROFAST's top: standing on the TROFAST she reaches it, so put a child lock on its push-open doors, or keep only washable, non-toxic supplies in it (final audit 2026-10-26). art-1 BLODFLÄDER (canvas, no glass) hangs between the table and the cabinet at her eye level.
bench-1 SMÅSTAD bench with toy storage (new in b), rot 270, x 41.4-61.9, y 43-78.4: along the KURA's open side at its foot, its back to the bed's frame, a seat and a toy box facing the play floor. F-32 open floor in front of the box; F-31 43.6" from the closet doors and 7.6" clear of the closet's and the door's 36" landings; F-33 50" from the heater face. No cushion on it, so no upholstery near the heater.
rug-1 VALLABY rot 0, x 59-98, y 36-88: the play floor in front of the toy bench, whose front feet stand on it, 14" from the heater face (F-33); its last 2" lie in the closet's landing, 6.5" short of the doors' arc.
canopy-1 LÖVA on the top wall over the KURA's head; mount it well above the 45 5/8" frame so she cannot climb the frame to it (IKEA: out of reach). lamp-1 UPPLYST inside the den on the left wall, cord fastened (IKEA). nightlight-1 TÖVÄDER and plant-1 FEJKA (artificial) on the TROFAST.
No dresser: clothes go in the 55" closet; toys in the TROFAST and the toy bench, books on the TROFAST's top and in the den, supplies in the BESTÅ unit. Maddie is 4 (F-21): every piece within her reach is under 27" or anchored; no glass anywhere; no loft or bunk. The play table ends 13.25" from the window wall beside the window, with its 11" chairs as a step up: fit window stops or guards on her window before she moves in (assumed-position:window, F-38; the sill is unmeasured).
Walkways (F-30): the 36" landings in front of the door and the closet are open floor (F-31); door to room along them and up past the toy bench's end, 43.6" below it; bed to play table past the bench.
Extras: ÅSVANG (4 3/4", under KURA's 5 1/8" maximum) with the DVALA fitted sheet (up to 10"), SMÅSPORRE insert, BARNDRÖM cover, low pillow, SKOGSDUVA cushions x2 for the den, BENGTA panel (cut to clear the heater, F-33) on the HUGAD rod (assumed-position:window), BESTÅ suspension rails x2. Not placed: the FLISAT book display ikea-80614566 (above).
Total $1,205.32: placed $907.89 + extras $297.43; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
Final audit 2026-10-26: the LÄTT's chairs moved to x 78-89 and 89-100, so the right one keeps 12" from the heater's face (it had 7.5"); the two safety lines of a and e are here too (window stops, and a lock on the BESTÅ, since the TROFAST under it is a step); a RÖDFLIK on the play table is her task light.
